from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import psutil

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = OUT.parents[1]
NATIVE = ROOT / ".runtime/qs013-verification/native_stack.py"


def main():
    records = []
    for process in psutil.process_iter(["pid", "cmdline"]):
        command = process.info["cmdline"] or []
        if not any(Path(arg).name == "history_open_size_modes.py" for arg in command):
            continue
        if "--child-label" not in command or str(OUT / "matrix") not in command:
            continue
        label = command[command.index("--child-label") + 1]
        accepted = {(OUT / "run_observation.py").as_posix(),
                    (OUT.relative_to(ROOT) / "run_observation.py").as_posix()}
        owners = [ancestor.cmdline() for ancestor in process.parents()]
        if not any(accepted.intersection(arg.replace("\\", "/") for arg in cmd) for cmd in owners):
            continue
        for child in process.children():
            cmd = child.cmdline()
            if not any("spawn_main" in arg for arg in cmd):
                continue
            threads = child.threads()
            if not threads:
                continue
            capture = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(NATIVE), str(child.pid), str(threads[0].id)],
                                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, timeout=15)
            records.append({"case": label, "pid": child.pid, "thread_id": threads[0].id,
                            "ownership_parent_pid": process.pid, "child_command": cmd,
                            "thread_inventory": [t.id for t in threads], "exitcode": capture.returncode,
                            "stderr": capture.stderr, "stdout": capture.stdout})
            print(json.dumps({"case": label, "pid": child.pid, "exitcode": capture.returncode}), flush=True)
    index = len(list(OUT.glob("live-case-native-*.json"))) + 1
    (OUT / f"live-case-native-{index:02}.json").write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Read a specific diagnostic child's native stack using local export symbols.

Only use the PID and TID shown in this investigation's child stack files.
The thread is resumed in a finally block; no process data is modified.
"""
import ctypes as c
import json
import sys
from ctypes import wintypes as w


class Address(c.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("Offset", c.c_uint64), ("Segment", w.WORD), ("Mode", w.DWORD)]


class Frame(c.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("AddrPC", Address), ("AddrReturn", Address), ("AddrFrame", Address),
                ("AddrStack", Address), ("AddrBStore", Address), ("FuncTableEntry", c.c_void_p),
                ("Params", c.c_uint64 * 4), ("Far", w.BOOL), ("Virtual", w.BOOL),
                ("Reserved", c.c_uint64 * 3), ("KdHelp", c.c_byte * 256)]


class Symbol(c.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("SizeOfStruct", w.DWORD), ("TypeIndex", w.DWORD), ("Reserved", c.c_uint64 * 2),
                ("Index", w.DWORD), ("Size", w.DWORD), ("ModBase", c.c_uint64), ("Flags", w.DWORD),
                ("Value", c.c_uint64), ("Address", c.c_uint64), ("Register", w.DWORD),
                ("Scope", w.DWORD), ("Tag", w.DWORD), ("NameLen", w.DWORD),
                ("MaxNameLen", w.DWORD), ("Name", c.c_char * 1)]


def main():
    kernel = c.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
    dbg = c.WinDLL("dbghelp", use_last_error=True)
    psapi = c.WinDLL("psapi", use_last_error=True)
    kernel.OpenProcess.argtypes = [w.DWORD, w.BOOL, w.DWORD]
    kernel.OpenProcess.restype = w.HANDLE
    kernel.OpenThread.argtypes = [w.DWORD, w.BOOL, w.DWORD]
    kernel.OpenThread.restype = w.HANDLE
    kernel.CloseHandle.argtypes = [w.HANDLE]
    kernel.SuspendThread.argtypes = [w.HANDLE]
    kernel.SuspendThread.restype = w.DWORD
    kernel.ResumeThread.argtypes = [w.HANDLE]
    kernel.GetThreadContext.argtypes = [w.HANDLE, c.c_void_p]
    dbg.SymInitialize.argtypes = [w.HANDLE, c.c_char_p, w.BOOL]
    dbg.SymCleanup.argtypes = [w.HANDLE]
    dbg.SymFunctionTableAccess64.argtypes = [w.HANDLE, c.c_uint64]
    dbg.SymFunctionTableAccess64.restype = c.c_void_p
    dbg.SymGetModuleBase64.argtypes = [w.HANDLE, c.c_uint64]
    dbg.SymGetModuleBase64.restype = c.c_uint64
    dbg.SymFromAddr.argtypes = [w.HANDLE, c.c_uint64, c.POINTER(c.c_uint64), c.c_void_p]
    dbg.StackWalk64.argtypes = [w.DWORD, w.HANDLE, w.HANDLE, c.POINTER(Frame), c.c_void_p,
                               c.c_void_p, c.c_void_p, c.c_void_p, c.c_void_p]
    psapi.GetModuleFileNameExW.argtypes = [w.HANDLE, w.HMODULE, w.LPWSTR, w.DWORD]
    pid, tid = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2], 0)
    process = kernel.OpenProcess(0x410, False, pid)
    if not process:
        raise c.WinError(c.get_last_error())
    thread = kernel.OpenThread(0x4A, False, tid)
    if not thread:
        kernel.CloseHandle(process)
        raise c.WinError(c.get_last_error())
    suspended = False
    initialized = False
    rows = []
    try:
        # Only local module/export symbols: no symbol-server downloads.
        dbg.SymSetOptions(0x2 | 0x4 | 0x10 | 0x200)
        if not dbg.SymInitialize(process, None, True):
            raise c.WinError(c.get_last_error())
        initialized = True
        if kernel.SuspendThread(thread) == 0xFFFFFFFF:
            raise c.WinError(c.get_last_error())
        suspended = True
        raw = c.create_string_buffer(1248)
        context = (c.addressof(raw) + 15) & ~15
        c.c_uint32.from_address(context + 48).value = 0x100003
        if not kernel.GetThreadContext(thread, context):
            raise c.WinError(c.get_last_error())
        frame = Frame()
        for attr, offset in [("AddrPC", 248), ("AddrFrame", 160), ("AddrStack", 152)]:
            address = getattr(frame, attr)
            address.Offset = c.c_uint64.from_address(context + offset).value
            address.Mode = 3
        for index in range(35):
            pc = frame.AddrPC.Offset
            if not pc:
                break
            buffer = c.create_string_buffer(c.sizeof(Symbol) + 1024)
            symbol = Symbol.from_buffer(buffer)
            symbol.SizeOfStruct = c.sizeof(Symbol)
            symbol.MaxNameLen = 1024
            displacement = c.c_uint64()
            found = dbg.SymFromAddr(process, pc, c.byref(displacement), buffer)
            base = dbg.SymGetModuleBase64(process, pc)
            module = c.create_unicode_buffer(1024)
            if base:
                psapi.GetModuleFileNameExW(process, base, module, 1024)
            rows.append({"frame": index, "pc": hex(pc), "module": module.value,
                         "symbol": c.string_at(c.addressof(buffer) + Symbol.Name.offset,
                                               symbol.NameLen).decode(errors="replace") if found else None,
                         "displacement": hex(displacement.value) if found else None})
            if not dbg.StackWalk64(0x8664, process, thread, c.byref(frame), context, None,
                                   c.cast(dbg.SymFunctionTableAccess64, c.c_void_p),
                                   c.cast(dbg.SymGetModuleBase64, c.c_void_p), None):
                break
    finally:
        if suspended:
            kernel.ResumeThread(thread)
        if initialized:
            dbg.SymCleanup(process)
        kernel.CloseHandle(thread)
        kernel.CloseHandle(process)
    print(json.dumps({"pid": pid, "tid": tid, "frames": rows}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
AUDIT = ROOT / "docs/investigations/quality-security-review-2026-10-06"


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    evidence = read(OUT / "matrix/evidence.json")
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    rows = []
    for trial in evidence["trials"]:
        result = trial["observation"]
        profile = result["profile"]
        preparation = result.get("preparation", {}).get("snapshots", [])
        stable_ids = [(s.get("device"), s.get("inode")) for s in preparation if s.get("exists")]
        missing = profile["workers"] - len(result.get("workers", []))
        row = {
            "label": result["label"], "condition": profile["name"], "mode": profile["mode"],
            "lifecycle": profile["lifecycle"], "initial_size": profile["initial_size"],
            "rounds": result.get("rounds"), "planned_rounds": profile["rounds"],
            "protocol_completed": result["protocol_completed"],
            "successful_operations_saved": result.get("successful_operations"),
            "errors_saved": result.get("errors"), "missing_worker_results": missing,
            "statistics_scope": "all_workers" if missing == 0 else "saved_workers_only",
            "pending_open_workers": sum(x["phase"] == "open" for x in result.get("long_pending_events", [])),
            "max_pending_seconds": max((x["last_observed_pending_seconds"]
                                        for x in result.get("long_pending_events", [])), default=0),
            "case_seconds": result.get("seconds"), "outer_timeout": trial["execution"]["timed_out"],
            "sizes_observed": "/".join(str(s.get("size", "missing")) for s in preparation),
            "same_observed_file_id": bool(stable_ids) and len(set(stable_ids)) == 1,
            "mtime_unchanged_observed": len({s.get("mtime_ns") for s in preparation if s.get("exists")}) == 1,
        }
        rows.append(row)
        groups[profile["name"]].append(row)
    csv_path = AUDIT / "workflow-history-open-size-modes-runs-2026-10-11.csv"
    with csv_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)
    aggregates = {name: {"rounds": [r["rounds"] for r in group],
                         "complete_trials": sum(r["protocol_completed"] for r in group),
                         "trials": len(group), "open_pending_trials": sum(r["pending_open_workers"] > 0 for r in group),
                         "pending_seconds": [r["max_pending_seconds"] for r in group],
                         "file_sizes": [r["sizes_observed"] for r in group],
                         "same_file_ids": all(r["same_observed_file_id"] for r in group),
                         "mtime_unchanged": all(r["mtime_unchanged_observed"] for r in group)}
                  for name, group in groups.items()}
    for name, aggregate in aggregates.items():
        print(name, json.dumps(aggregate), flush=True)
    before, after = read(OUT / "environment-before.json"), read(OUT / "environment-after.json")
    prior = read(ROOT / ".runtime/history-lock-reinstalled-20261011-1913/environment-final.json")
    protocol = read(OUT / "protocol.json")
    assert len(rows) == 24
    assert before["source_sha256"] == after["source_sha256"] == prior["source_sha256"]
    assert digest(AUDIT / "probes/history_open_size_modes.py") == evidence["probe_sha256"]
    assert digest(AUDIT / "probes/history_lock_variability.py") == evidence["orchestration_sha256"]
    assert all(r["same_observed_file_id"] for r in rows if r["lifecycle"].startswith("stable"))
    assert all(not w["product_modules_before"] and not w["product_modules_after"]
               for t in evidence["trials"] for w in t["observation"].get("workers", []))
    startup = {p.relative_to(OUT).as_posix(): read(p) for p in (OUT / "matrix").rglob("startup-*.json")}
    assert all(not item["product_modules"] and item["guard64"]["loaded"] for item in startup.values())
    native = {p.name: read(p) for p in OUT.glob("live-case-native-*.json")}
    latency_counts = [w["open_latency"]["count"] for t in evidence["trials"]
                      for w in t["observation"].get("workers", [])]
    latency_maxima = [w["open_latency"]["max_seconds"] for t in evidence["trials"]
                      for w in t["observation"].get("workers", [])
                      if w["open_latency"]["max_seconds"] is not None]
    record = {
        "recorded_at": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(), "protocol": protocol,
        "environment_before": before, "environment_after": after, "integrity": read(OUT / "integrity.json"),
        "execution": read(OUT / "matrix-execution.json"), "matrix": evidence,
        "startup_worker_inventories": startup, "native_captures": native,
        "native_capture_helper_source": (OUT / "capture_live_case.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        "native_stack_reader_source": (ROOT / ".runtime/qs013-verification/native_stack.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        "aggregates": aggregates,
        "totals": {"trials": len(rows), "protocol_completed": sum(r["protocol_completed"] for r in rows),
                   "open_pending_trials": sum(r["pending_open_workers"] > 0 for r in rows),
                   "missing_worker_results": sum(r["missing_worker_results"] for r in rows),
                   "saved_returned_open_calls": sum(latency_counts),
                   "max_saved_returned_open_seconds": max(latency_maxima),
                   "planned_calls": sum(t["observation"]["planned_attempts"] for t in evidence["trials"]),
                   "errors_saved": sum(r["errors_saved"] for r in rows)},
        "outside_sandbox": True,
        "comparison_to_prior_reinstall": {
            "environment_fields_match": {key: before[key] == prior[key] for key in (
                "python", "windows", "packages", "guard64_loaded", "loaded_guard64_path",
            )},
            "security_fields_match": {key: before["security"][key] == prior["security"][key]
                                      for key in ("boot_time", "security_products",
                                                  "selected_comodo_driver_registrations")},
            "installed_security_file_versions_hashes_match": (
                before["installed_security_details"]["files"] == prior["installed_security_details"]["files"]
            ),
            "source_test_config_hashes_match": before["source_sha256"] == prior["source_sha256"],
        },
        "setup_diagnostic_failure": "Sandbox WMI/CIM read was denied before tests; retried outside sandbox successfully.",
        "official_references": ["https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/functions.html#open",
                                "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python/cpython/v3.11.4/Modules/_io/fileio.c"],
        "sources": {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): {"sha256": digest(p), "source": p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")}
                    for p in (AUDIT / "probes/history_open_size_modes.py", OUT / "run_observation.py", Path(__file__))},
        "scratch_artifact_sha256": {p.relative_to(OUT).as_posix(): digest(p) for p in sorted(OUT.rglob("*"))
                                    if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in p.parts},
        "tracked_product_diff": subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", "diff", "--stat", "--", "src", "tests", "pyproject.toml", ".github"], cwd=ROOT, text=True),
    }
    (AUDIT / "raw/workflow-history-open-size-modes-evidence-2026-10-11.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (OUT / "aggregates.json").write_text(json.dumps(aggregates, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(record["totals"], indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
